review_scope: Targeted follow-up of the three critical mapped questions, six B705 proposals, and four additional held cases. This is not a repeated 878-question audit or independent clinical validation.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Direct self-harm safety item is assigned to NP V teamwork; verify specific section support and avoid implying complete/local crisis protocol.
evidence_checked: Full canonical stem, choices, key and rationale
Exact lesson/section and production practice pool
cases.finding: The section teaches the keyed direct inquiry and immediate-safety response. Taxonomy remains nle-np-v-teamwork. NIMH is U.S.-jurisdiction-limited; WHO is global guidance. Neither proves a Philippine/facility pathway.
cases.proposed_action: A PRC taxonomy owner should select the defensible NP V concept or document why teamwork is intended. A psychiatric nurse educator should review scope, wording and local-pathway limits.
cases.production_change: None to mapping or canonical record.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Ileostomy output, dizziness and hydration/electrolyte assessment are classified as nle-np-iv-endocrine.
cases.finding: The stem is gastrointestinal/fluid-pattern oriented; the catalog has nle-np-iv-gastrointestinal and nle-np-iii-fluids concepts. A concept change still requires taxonomy-owner confirmation of intended NP level and blueprint scope.
cases.proposed_action: Ask the taxonomy owner to choose the intended gastrointestinal/fluid concept and NP level, then update the canonical concept only with explicit review evidence and taxonomy regression tests.
cases.production_change: None; no exact section mapping exists.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Direct suicide-risk assessment item is classified as NP V shock.
cases.finding: The keyed construct is direct safety assessment; shock is not evident from the stem. Crisis and therapeutic concepts exist, but the intended blueprint placement needs taxonomy-owner review.
cases.proposed_action: Confirm the intended mental-health/crisis concept against the official blueprint before any taxonomy edit. Preserve answer and rationale pending expert review.
cases.production_change: None; no exact section mapping exists.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Safety-plan documentation/communication item is classified as NP V acuity.
cases.finding: The item addresses continuity after suicide-risk assessment. Crisis, therapeutic and teamwork concepts may be relevant; the correct concept cannot be selected from wording alone.
cases.proposed_action: Have the taxonomy owner identify the intended construct and verify the exact blueprint element. Do not change the key or taxonomy in this batch.
cases.production_change: None; no exact section mapping exists.

cases.issue_hypothesis: The phrase at risk of self-harm does not state whether suicidal intent or an immediate safety plan has been established; the item asks for an action that may depend on that context.
evidence_checked: B705 reviewer queue and psychiatric safety source limits
cases.finding: The stem does not describe the assessment finding, plan or role-specific precautions needed to distinguish routine privacy from an immediate safety risk.
cases.proposed_action: A psychiatric nurse educator should decide what clinical context is intended and specify the safety-plan condition needed for one best answer. Draft a revised item only after that decision; do not infer a protocol.
cases.production_change: None; no exact section mapping exists.

cases.origin: B705 dose-basis proposal and B706 safety review
cases.issue_hypothesis: mg/kg quantity lacks per-dose/per-day basis and may be read as medication preparation instruction.
evidence_checked: Full canonical stem, choices, key and rationale
B705 verified Open RN dose-calculation text
Medication lesson section and HTTP/answer-review path
cases.finding: Arithmetic is correct (0.25 mg/kg × 68 kg = 17 mg); no drug, interval or dose-time basis establishes clinical validity.
cases.proposed_action: A nurse educator and pharmacist should specify whether the intended construct is mg/kg/dose arithmetic or another basis. If revised, explicitly state the time basis and preserve separation from order validation.
cases.production_change: Removed exact section fields and item from lesson practice pool; retained both source IDs and Nursing exam eligibility.

cases.origin: B705 dose-basis proposal and B706 safety review
cases.issue_hypothesis: Pediatric mg/kg quantity lacks per-dose/per-day basis; keyed volume is arithmetic only.
evidence_checked: Full canonical stem, choices, key and rationale
B705 verified Open RN dose-calculation text
Medication lesson section and HTTP/answer-review path
cases.finding: Arithmetic is correct (15 mg/kg × 18 kg = 270 mg; 270 mg ÷ 75 mg/mL = 3.6 mL); no medication, interval, duration or time basis establishes clinical validity.
cases.proposed_action: A pediatric medication-safety reviewer and pharmacist should define the intended basis and determine whether the generic stem can support one answer without implying a valid pediatric order.
cases.production_change: Removed exact section fields and item from lesson practice pool; retained both source IDs and Nursing exam eligibility.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Pale, limp newborn transition scenario may require current newborn emergency/resuscitation instruction absent from the exact section and full-text verified source set.
cases.finding: No exact section teaches the specific pale/limp transition response. The cited WHO newborn-resuscitation source was metadata-only/dated in B705 evidence; no threshold or protocol was verified here.
cases.proposed_action: Obtain a current authoritative neonatal resuscitation source and neonatal nurse educator decision on the stem/key before linking or rewriting.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Cancer-treatment-specific infection guidance is being generalized to unspecified immunosuppressive therapy.
evidence_checked: Current lesson scope and source IDs
B705 source ledger identifying NCI page review date 2020 and cancer-specific scope
cases.finding: The existing lesson explicitly limits NCI evidence to cancer/cancer treatment and does not establish a threshold or pathway for all immune-modifying therapy. Production links are source-only, not exact.
cases.proposed_action: An infection/oncology nurse educator should identify the treatment context and current authoritative source required for an exact teaching claim.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Unspecified immunosuppressive therapy and a current febrile-risk pathway are not supported by the cancer-specific source.
evidence_checked: Current lesson scope and source IDs
B705 source ledger identifying NCI page review date 2020 and cancer-specific scope
cases.finding: The stem invokes a treatment-specific pathway but names neither therapy nor local protocol. Existing source-only provenance does not support exact instruction.
cases.proposed_action: A nurse educator should specify the intended treatment/population and obtain current medication- or disease-specific guidance before changing the item or adding a section.

cases.issue_hypothesis: Question implies a medication-related gait change but omits age/drug; the cited dizziness source context is older-adult-specific.
cases.finding: Fall protection and communicating a new change are broad safety actions, but the record does not establish medication causality or an age-specific claim. No exact section supports the full keyed principle.
cases.proposed_action: A nurse educator and pharmacist should decide whether to remove implied causality or specify the population and medication context, then verify a suitable source.
